name: tournamentsoftware.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 56 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.tournamentsoftware.com scores 66 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: 56 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 56 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /cookiewall/, /support/privacy, /cookiewall/ViewAdProviders, /cookiewall/?returnurl=%2Ftournaments and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /cookiewall/, for example #SelectedLCID. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /cookiewall/ViewAdProviders, for example #a6d36add-498a-4ea6-b3f0-42a4620b09e6. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 16 pages, ChatGPT-User cannot read 16 pages, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 16 pages, Claude-User cannot read 16 pages.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 21 elements on /cookiewall/, /support/privacy, /cookiewall/ViewAdProviders, for example a[href$="privacy"] and .js-accept-basic > .nav-link__value. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".
